description.zh: 物联网平台为设备颁发的ID，是设备的唯一标识符。调用[QuerySpeechDevice](~~280408~~)可以获取该参数。
description.en: The ID issued by the IoT Platform for a device, which serves as the device's unique identifier. You can obtain this parameter by invoking [QuerySpeechDevice](~~280408~~).

description.zh:
实例ID。

必须传入实例ID，否则调用会失败。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看您的实例ID。
><notice>
如果公共实例没有ID，请参见[如何获取实例ID](~~267533~~)。
></notice>
description.en:
The instance ID.

You must specify an instance ID; otherwise, the invocation will fail. You can view your instance ID on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.
><notice>
If your public instance does not have an ID, see [How to Obtain an Instance ID](~~267533~~).
></notice>
The current page number, starting from 1. Maximum value is 10000.

description.zh: 指定每页返回数据的最大条数，取值范围：1~50，默认值为20。
description.en: The maximum number of entries to return per page. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value: 20.
